cases.prompt: Set up repository instructions for multiple coding agents working on an equipment-control codebase.
required_behaviors: recognizes instruction hierarchy, risk routing, ownership, worktree and evidence needs
distinguishes repository governance from product architecture
forbidden_behaviors: creates generic rules without inspecting the repository
lets agents edit the same critical files concurrently
baseline_expected_failure: agent provides only commit naming rules
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Define how agents may modify a database migration and device-control workflow in parallel.
required_behaviors: assigns integrator ownership and isolated worktrees
requires migration copies, rollback and real verification states
forbidden_behaviors: allows parallel edits to the same migration or command owner
baseline_expected_failure: agent optimizes concurrency but ignores consequence and integration
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Design an AI agent that reads Outlook mail and decides whether to update a ticket.
required_behaviors: does not treat AGENTS.md as the product design
forbidden_behaviors: focuses on branches instead of autonomy and tool risk
baseline_expected_failure: agent confuses the repository worker with the agent product
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
